learned: 2026-10-17: adkhempco.com/coas/ is one static page of ~63 self-hosted PDFs, one per strain/format/month.
notes: Filenames are strain[-format]-YYYY-MM.pdf; format is preroll, infused-preroll, multipack, live-rosin, rosin-cart, or none (flower).
